purpose: Dressing pass 3 (D193): Hushwell's uniform dim cave floor and empty miners' level, the repeated nursery cradles, and the Gullet's single tiled membrane floor.
generator: Meshy text-to-image decal sheets (cave patches and Gullet patches with background removal; mine rails and coil scour as white-background tiles) cut by tools/dressing_decals3.py; Meshy gpt-image-2 image-to-image kit board styled from the P40 Hushwell kit board and the P41 props board; tools/isolate_board.py; Meshy T2 image-to-3D at 4000 triangles.
referenceReview: All four decal sheets opened. Background removal erased two of the six cave patches (damp seep: a faint ghost; crystal shards: empty); those cells are skipped by name, not regenerated. The mine-rail tile repeats every 129.7 px (three sleepers per measured 389 px period); the scour tile every 128 px. The six-cell board opened: six clean, separated, style-matched objects.
meshReview: All six Blender four-view sheets opened (views/). Every model complete and connected from all sides; no trims. Lamp head and power-cell socket face front; the rail buffer's rails run along local x (RoomDressing turns local x onto the line).
processing: Embedded textures stripped (p64_strip_embedded). Emission masks: work lamp and rail buffer 'lamp' key (amber glass); crystal, cradles and power cell cyan. Decals: cave and Gullet patches cut per grid cell and feathered (fissures left sharp: feathering erased the crack lines on the first cut, which was opened and rejected); the egg glow keyed pale blue-white (the cyan key found 0.08 %); the vein patch's own dark tissue faded to a 22 % tint around solid vessels after the first render showed dark rectangular halos; the scour band feathered toward both edges after the first render showed a hard striped ribbon.
intake: GenIntake.BuildPrefix with -intake-prefix DressWorkLamp,DressRailBuffer,DressPowerCell,HushwellWallCrystal,HushwellCradleHatched,HushwellCradleSingle staged exactly these six prefabs under Prefabs/Environment. RoomDressing stages the twelve decal textures to Art/Generated/Dressing.
